resources.string: Nakshatra AI utilizes the Accessibility Service to automate pressing the Send button in WhatsApp after you confirm your message.

About Nakshatra AI:
 Nakshatra AI is your smart personal assistant designed to help with voice commands, web searches, and daily tasks quickly and efficiently.

 Zero Data Collection:
 Your privacy is our absolute priority. Nakshatra AI does not collect, store, sell, or share any of your personal data.

 Chat & Voice Privacy:
 We do not monitor your conversations. Your chat history and voice inputs are processed securely and are never harvested or stored on external servers.

 Device Permissions:
 Microphone and Contacts permissions are strictly used locally on your device to provide core functionality. We do not extract or upload this information.
